# `TuningGroup`

Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap (`TuningGroup`: `Card` + `Field` + `Badge`) · status: kit gap

## Anatomy

A `card` (`comp: 'TuningGroup'`) that holds tuning parameters: description with a "mặc định" / "Tùy chỉnh" badge on the left, a labelled field with its range hint on the right, rows divided by `hr`.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

**Composition.** One group of tuning parameters: each param is the description with a "mặc định" / "Tùy chỉnh" badge on the left and a labelled `field` with its range hint on the right, rows divided by `hr`. WJ105-WJ115
